speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis (Listeria monocytogenes infection). The combination of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise in a 30-week pregnant patient with a specific exposure to soft-ripened cheeses or unpasteurized dairy (often associated with ice cream or similar products) strongly suggests this diagnosis.
